title: Predicted Fgf10a–Fgfr2b complex (Boltz-2) with a non-cognate Fgfr2c control that scored higher: no specificity signal
evidence_kind: PREDICTED: a computed structure hypothesis, not an observed structure

model.name: Boltz-2 complex prediction, 3 samples each, PDB70 MSA per chain
model.context: Fgf10a core (Q8AY90 58-201) with Fgfr2 IIIb D2-D3 (F1RBT3 150-360); control: Fgfr2 IIIc D2-D3 (Q8JG38 150-362). IIIb chosen by alignment to human P21802-3 vs -1.

numerical_checks.name: cognate IIIb: confidence / pTM / interface pLDDT (top)
non-cognate IIIc control: confidence / pTM / interface pLDDT (top)
receptor interface residues inside the IIIb/IIIc alternative exon

parameter_unknowns: Confidence scores are not affinities; no ddG was computed (stab_ddg needs an undocumented upload manifest, blocked).
open_questions: Would a deep (UniRef) MSA or AlphaFold3 discriminate IIIb from IIIc? Would MD separate them?
limitations: MSA is PDB70-only (structural database, 14-122 sequences), so homologous crystal structures may be templated.
The negative control failed to discriminate, so the predictor is not informative about isoform choice here.
does_not_establish: FGF10-FGFR2b isoform specificity (the non-cognate control scores higher)
that this complex forms in the zebrafish or flying-fish pectoral fin bud
